cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# The Pokémon Emerald Battle Companion (CODE_PLAN.md). This is a standalone
# Qt project, independent of the pokeemerald ROM build one directory up --
# configure/build it from *this* directory, not the repo root:
#
#   cmake -S helperapp -B helperapp/build
#   cmake --build helperapp/build
#
# config/ holds the runtime-loaded symbol table and struct layout JSON
# (Phase 1.3/1.4, regenerated by ../tools/gen_symbols.py and
# ../tools/gen_struct_layout.py against a built pokeemerald_modern.map).
project(emerald_companion LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets Network)

set(POKEEMERALD_ROOT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..)

# Phase 5: move outcome calculation over a struct BattleState that mirrors
# the game's battle globals one for one -- ported (not reimplemented) from
# the decomp's own CalculateBaseDamage(), battle script commands and
# battle scripts. Compiled as C, against the real pokeemerald headers/data
# one directory up wherever those are include-safe for a host tool -- see
# calc/include/battle_state.h and emerald_calc.h.
add_library(emerald_calc STATIC
    calc/src/battle_util.c
    calc/src/damage.c
    calc/src/game_data.c
    calc/src/ko.c
    calc/src/move_scripts.c
    calc/src/tables.c
)

# include/constants, reachable as "constants/foo.h" exactly as the decomp
# spells it (nested includes like flags.h's "constants/opponents.h"
# included) through a directory whose only entry is a `constants` symlink
# -- *not* by putting include/ itself on the search path, where pret's
# include/strings.h shadows libc's <strings.h>.
set(PRET_CONSTANTS_SHIM ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pret_constants)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${PRET_CONSTANTS_SHIM})
file(CREATE_LINK ${POKEEMERALD_ROOT}/include/constants ${PRET_CONSTANTS_SHIM}/constants SYMBOLIC)

# sSpeciesToNationalPokedexNum (Low Kick's weight lookup goes species ->
# national dex number -> Pokedex entry) is a static table inside
# src/pokemon.c rather than a data header, so its initializer is copied out
# of pokemon.c verbatim at configure time instead of being transcribed.
set(EMERALD_CALC_GENERATED ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/calc_generated)
file(READ ${POKEEMERALD_ROOT}/src/pokemon.c _pokemon_c)
string(REGEX MATCH "static const u16 sSpeciesToNationalPokedexNum\\[NUM_SPECIES - 1\\] =[^;]*;"
       _species_to_national "${_pokemon_c}")
if(NOT _species_to_national)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "sSpeciesToNationalPokedexNum not found in src/pokemon.c")
endif()
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT ${EMERALD_CALC_GENERATED}/species_to_national_dex.h
     CONTENT "/* Generated by helperapp/CMakeLists.txt from src/pokemon.c -- do not edit. */\n${_species_to_national}\n")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${POKEEMERALD_ROOT}/src/pokemon.c)

# PUBLIC: battle_state.h/emerald_calc.h #include "constants/..." headers
# themselves, so consumers need the shim too.
target_include_directories(emerald_calc PUBLIC
    calc/include
    ${PRET_CONSTANTS_SHIM})
target_include_directories(emerald_calc PRIVATE
    ${POKEEMERALD_ROOT}/src        # data/battle_moves.h, data/pokemon/*.h (game_data.c only)
    ${EMERALD_CALC_GENERATED})
set_target_properties(emerald_calc PROPERTIES AUTOMOC OFF) # plain C, no Q_OBJECT

# Phase 2/3's pure decode/transport layers, with no Qt Widgets or socket
# dependency, so tests/ can link just this and run with no emulator and no
# GUI event loop involved.
add_library(emerald_core STATIC
    src/symboltable.cpp
    src/structlayout.cpp
    src/frameparser.cpp
    src/partydecoder.cpp
    src/decoder.cpp
    src/nametable.cpp
    src/battlerview.cpp
)
target_include_directories(emerald_core PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(emerald_core PUBLIC Qt6::Core Qt6::Network emerald_calc)

add_executable(emerald_companion
    src/main.cpp
    src/memorybridge.cpp
    src/mainwindow.cpp
    # Listed explicitly (not just #included) so AUTOMOC's header scan finds
    # their Q_OBJECT macros -- its same-basename-as-a-.cpp heuristic doesn't
    # reliably match across the include/ vs src/ directory split this
    # project uses.
    include/emerald/mainwindow.h
    include/emerald/memorybridge.h
)
# AUTOMOC needs this target's own include dirs set directly -- it doesn't
# reliably pick up include paths inherited transitively from a PRIVATE-linked
# library when scanning this target's headers for Q_OBJECT.
target_include_directories(emerald_companion PRIVATE include)
target_link_libraries(emerald_companion PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets Qt6::Network emerald_core)
target_compile_definitions(emerald_companion PRIVATE
    EMERALD_CONFIG_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config")

option(EMERALD_BUILD_TESTS "Build helperapp unit tests" ON)
if(EMERALD_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
